scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run tests
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace frontend && npm run test:coverage --workspace infrastructure
scripts.quality:gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
scripts.cdk:diff:staging: npm run diff --workspace infrastructure -- --context stage=staging DuttaDrawFoundationStackStaging
scripts.cdk:diff:prod: npm run diff --workspace infrastructure -- --context stage=prod DuttaDrawFoundationStackProd
scripts.cdk:deploy:staging: npm run deploy --workspace infrastructure -- --context stage=staging DuttaDrawFoundationStackStaging
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: npm run deploy --workspace infrastructure -- --context stage=prod DuttaDrawFoundationStackProd
scripts.cdk:destroy:staging: npm run destroy --workspace infrastructure -- --context stage=staging DuttaDrawFoundationStackStaging
